scope: Calibrate VM count-image RMS variance, pixel quantization and per-observation noise; run a new matched-budget baseline only after calibration passes
variance_definition: Pixel-center central second moment minus pixel_width_mm squared / 12; no clipping or distribution-specific fitting
noise_definition: sqrt((fourth_central_moment - (N-3)/(N-1) * second_central_moment squared) / N), computed from each VM particle-count frame
noise_validation: Held-out frame minus calibration mean, divided by sqrt(frame noise variance plus calibration-mean noise variance); no fitted inflation factor

benchmark.forecast_noise_interpretation: Existing fixed future-query noise assumption retained; only revealed observations receive per-frame noise estimates. No hidden reference or future frame enters pool noise.
benchmark.observations: Actual positive corrected RMS variances from independent elegant particle populations; paired policies reuse the same query-indexed frame, with no additive Gaussian perturbation
benchmark.reference: Frozen primary corrected-image full-scan reference, audited against entrance particle covariance; finite precision, not absolute truth

failure_policy: Retain all invalid frames, nonphysical references, quality failures and unavailable recommendations; no retries, clipping, sample rejection or projection
continuation: Preserve B2/B3. Calibration failure closes P2-B4 before policy comparison. A benchmark failure preserves the new result and keeps GUI acceptance blocked. No GP/acquisition/inference tuning or real-machine connection.
